gloss: student studying for another attempt at entrance exams

definitions.gloss: student retaking entrance exams; ronin student
definitions.explanation: A student who failed university entrance exams and is spending a year (or more) studying to retake them. These students typically attend prep schools (予備校) full-time while preparing for the next round of exams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{浪人生|ろうにんせい}だ。
{浪人生|ろうにんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一年間|いちねんかん}→一年間：28882_ichinenkan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{辛|つら}かった→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
examples.english: The year as a ronin student was tough.

examples.japanese: {浪人生|ろうにんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予備校|よびこう}→予備校：04785_yobikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{第一志望|だいいちしぼう}→第一志望：19697_daiichishibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: The ronin student is attending a prep school while aiming for their first-choice university.

notes:
A culturally specific term in Japan's education system. After failing to gain admission to their desired university, some students choose to spend a gap year studying intensively rather than attending a less preferred school.

FORMS:
⟦{浪人|ろうにん}→浪人：13301_rounin⟧ (ronin; masterless samurai → person without a fixed position) + {生|せい} (student). The term borrows from the historical concept of a samurai without a lord, metaphorically applied to students without a school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {浪人生|ろうにんせい}{活|かつ}: ronin student life
- {一浪|いちろう}: one year of ronin study
- {二浪|にろう}: two years of ronin study
- {浪人生|ろうにんせい}{向|む}け: aimed at ronin students

CULTURAL NOTE:
Being a {浪人生|ろうにんせい} carries some social stigma but is extremely common. Many prestigious universities have a significant proportion of students who entered after one or more years of ⟦{浪人|ろうにん}→浪人：13301_rounin⟧. The experience is often described as character-building despite its difficulty.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{予備校|よびこう}→予備校：04785_yobikou⟧: cram school/prep school — where most {浪人生|ろうにんせい} study
- ⟦{現役|げんえき}→現役：21782_geneki⟧: a student who passes on their first attempt (contrasted with ⟦{浪人|ろうにん}→浪人：13301_rounin⟧)
